# Nymrel Trust Scorecard

> Nymrel Trust Scorecard is a deterministic AI Agent Readiness and Machine Trust audit engine. It evaluates any web domain across 5 core dimensions: AI Discovery & Orientation, Entity Graph & Provenance, Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) Offers, Autonomous Machine Payments (x402 / AP2 / ACP), and AI Crawler discoverability.

## Core Capabilities & Endpoints

- Web App: https://score.nymrel.com
- GitHub Repo: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-trust-scorecard
- Machine Trust Standard: https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust
- Universal Commerce Protocol: https://github.com/nymrel/open-ucp
- Agentic Scanner CLI: https://github.com/nymrel/agentic-ucp-scanner

## Machine Trust Dimensions

1. **Discovery & Orientation (20 pts)**: Presence of standard `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, sitemaps, and machine index headers.
2. **Entity Graph & Provenance (20 pts)**: Rich Schema.org JSON-LD with verified `parentOrganization` (e.g. Nymrel -> JalenBuilds LLC), legal entity registration, and contact points.
3. **Intent & Commerce Offers (20 pts)**: Structured Schema.org `Product`, `Offer`, ISO 4217 currencies, real-time availability, and merchant return policies.
4. **Machine Payments & Checkout (20 pts)**: Native HTTP 402 / x402 headers, AP2/ACP negotiation, headless Stripe agent links, and crypto/stablecoin rails.
5. **AI Crawler Access (20 pts)**: Explicit permissions for `OAI-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, and avoiding blanket crawl blocks.
